name: The late carer bridging the night taken ill
description: Wednesday's night carer doesn't come and nobody covers: Aisha stays on until Nikos arrives from the main building at 22:42, but her norovirus starts at 22:00. The floating carer covers until Nikos comes, and Nikos works the night; Stan's minor fall at 01:44 is lifted promptly. While building PR B, the cover rule booked Nikos twice (for a gap ending before it began) and he stopped working, so Stan lay on the floor for hours. (Fuzz case 02728.)
